## Updraft 0.7.1

- **New slim pill.** The pill shrinks to a thin line when you're not using it. Point at the line and it grows into a small pill with Dictate and Meeting. Hold the dictation key and it opens into a voice wave that moves with your voice. When you let go, the wave pulses while it types, then shows "Done". Clicking the pill never pulls your cursor out of the app you're typing in.
- **Off until you turn it on.** Go to Settings > General and turn on "Slim pill". Turn it off any time to get the old pill back.
- **Just as fast.** The slim pill was tested against the old pill on the gaming PC and the Mac before it shipped. Dictation is just as fast with it on.

**To update:** Settings > About > Check for updates.
